# GitHub Actions disabled

Market Signal Lab does not use GitHub Actions/CI as a build, test, verification, release, keepalive, or recovery mechanism.

Local verification is the execution authority. Stable local gates must not be repeated on GitHub-hosted runners merely to push, integrate, or publish a release.

Executable workflow YAML files are intentionally absent from this directory.

This policy may change only after an explicit operator instruction that replaces the current permanent ban.
